Request routing involves directing each request to the appropriate GPU. Queueing might be using FIFO or priority queues to manage incoming requests. Tail latency refers to the time a request takes to complete after being processed. Cache transfer is about moving data between the GPU cache and main memory. Role switching could mean switching between different prefill stages
